outcome: Motor development at 10, 14, and 17 years of age
cohort: 2868 participants from the Western Australian Pregnancy Cohort Study
finding: Maternal pre-eclampsia, Caesarean section, and low income were negatively associated with motor development in both boys and girls, while other factors showed sex-specific associations.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was negatively associated with motor development in both boys and girls.
